feeds.title: Simone Walsh Blog
feeds.description: Jewellery articles by Australian jewellery designer Simone Walsh. Get jewellery style tips, care advice, info about precious metals and more.

feeds.title: JewelCover Blog
feeds.description: Jewel Cover Blog provides interesting articles on engagement rings, jewellery insurance, watch insurance, and more. Check out the blog for handy insurance info, easy-to-use guides, helpful tips, and customer resources.

feeds.title: Artelia Jewellery Blog
feeds.description: A well-established jewellery manufacturer, Artelia has been manufacturing bespoke jewellery in Australia since the early 1990s. It is a second generation jewellery house founded by their passion for unique, personal and exceptional quality jewellery. They provide guides and tips for choosing the perfect piece to last a lifetime.

feeds.title: Jewellery World
feeds.description: Established in 1981, JW Magazine is Australia and New Zealand's premiere industry magazine with the largest distribution, published eleven times a year. Created for retail jewellers, manufacturers, wholesalers and salespeople, the Magazine provides insider knowledge on the latest in industry trade and current affairs. It is invaluable to anyone attuned to the industry, wanting to be at the forefront of key trends and developments in jewellery and watches.

feeds.title: Indie and Harper Blog
feeds.description: Indie and Harper is a Bohemian Brand that empowers women through Jewellery and much more. They educate through our blogs about the benefits of different gem stones like moonstones and turquoise. Indie and Harper also chat about the different Birthstone Jewellery and the benefits linked to them.

feeds.title: Taylor & Hart's Blog
feeds.description: Taylor & Hart's are redefining the rules of engagement with a collaborative approach, exceptional quality at every price point, and technology that places you at the center of the design process. Find out all you need to know about engagement rings - from diamond and gemstone guidance to trends and proposal inspiration.

feeds.title: Cosmopolitan Jewellers Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1992, Cosmopolitan Jewellers has gained an unsurpassed reputation for excellence in design, manufacturing and service. They are Australia's largest retailer of designer Black & Boulder Opal jewellery. Their modern, luxurious store in the heart of the Rocks, Sydney, is one of the largest of its type in Australia carrying the most beautiful collection of the finest quality Opal and Pearl jewellery. Check out their latest blogs about Opals, Pearls, Diamonds, Gemstones etc.

feeds.title: Geneine Honey Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2002 by designer, mother and maker Geneine Honey, they are a Melbourne based design house with a focus on sustainability and artisanship in their handmade jewellery. They have a commitment to creating beautiful pieces in high quality materials, and continually remodel, repair and recycle to create ethically minded future heirlooms. They also offer custom consultations to create personalized jewelery and re-use gemstones and materials from existing heirlooms. The blog provides their collections, designs, and more.

feeds.title: Anania Jewellers Blog
feeds.description: In 1965 Orfeo opened a small workshop in Sydney and was commissioned by Jewellery Retailers all over Australia to design and make Jewellery. They will love the thought and time you have put into creating a piece of Jewellery with us. Check out their latest articles on Anania's official Journal.

feeds.title: Monty Adams Jewellery Blog
feeds.description: Monty Adams Jewellery Concierge is your private jeweller for life. They provide you with a curated experience at prices significantly cheaper than retail. Their consultative approach is the key to guiding you toward the best possible solution to suit your needs and budget. Their blog provides you with the latest cutting-edge jewellery content, news stories and more!
